spec_raw: Pagination numbers overlap when there are many pages, and pagination should follow the component sizing scale

spec_refined.title: Pagination: sizing-scale compliance and overflow handling
spec_refined.description: Two coupled defects: (1) pagination does not follow the library sizing scale (sm/md/lg heights and paddings); (2) with many pages the page numbers overlap instead of truncating with ellipses. Implement the sizing scale and a windowed page display (first, last, current +/- neighbors, ellipsis separators).
acceptance_criteria: size='sm'|'md'|'lg' produce heights matching the library sizing scale tokens
With more pages than the display window, ellipsis items appear and no overlap occurs
First and last pages are always reachable
Current page +/- 1 neighbors are always visible
Keyboard navigation works across truncated layouts (ellipsis items are skipped)
pageChange events fire with correct page numbers after truncation
Existing pagination tests pass; new behavior covered
spec_refined.technical_notes: Windowing algorithm + sizing refactor across the same component: layered change with regression risk on events.
